generate.pipelineFlow: Requirement Parsing → Contract Generation → Code Generation → Repair → Simulation → HITL Human Review → Report

placeholder.req: e.g. Implement a low-pass filter with a 10 Hz cutoff to remove high-frequency sensor noise...

example.req1: Implement a low-pass filter with a 10 Hz cutoff to remove high-frequency sensor noise
example.req2: Implement a PID controller (Kp=2.0, Ki=0.5, Kd=0.1) to control the UAV pitch angle
example.req3: Implement an ARINC 429 word parsing function that decodes a 32-bit word into label, SDI, and data
example.req4: Implement a redundancy manager that averages two redundant channels and raises an alarm when deviation exceeds 5%

hitl.enabledTitle: HITL enabled: the pipeline pauses at review checkpoints awaiting human approval
hitl.disabledTitle: HITL disabled: the pipeline runs the full flow without pausing

empty.hint: Enter a requirement on the left and click Generate
empty.resultHint: Generated results will be shown here once the pipeline completes

degraded.title: ⚠ Degraded Mode
degraded.desc: LLM unavailable; the Agent followed the degraded (mock) path. Code was generated from templates and may not reflect the actual requirement. Check the LLM settings.

verify.title: Formal Verification
verify.subtitle: Z3 SMT + CBMC bounded model check

error.generateFailed: Generation failed. Please check whether the backend service is running.
